abstract: Monitors electrical auxiliary systems, on-site backup generator availability, and auxiliary fuel autonomy
system_message:
You are Emergency utilities coordinator (PWR). The Emergency utilities coordinator (PWR) monitors electrical auxiliary systems, on-site backup generator availability, auxiliary fuel autonomy, and emergency utility storage across potential evacuation shelters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors electrical auxiliary systems, on-site backup generator availability, and auxiliary fuel autonomy（UTIL）
information_points.content:
PWR-UTIL-0KL：According to assessments conducted in the Production environment, Bayside Civic Pavilion confirms active backup generator readiness, with auxiliary storage supporting a backup generator continuous fuel autonomy of 24 h.
PWR-UTIL-8DP：Evaluated in the Production environment, Highland Sports Arena maintains active backup generator readiness, and its dedicated fuel reserves provide a backup generator continuous fuel autonomy of 48 h.
PWR-UTIL-O2Q：When evaluated within the Staging simulation environment, Highland Sports Arena does not demonstrate active backup generator readiness, while the simulated fuel reserve reflects a backup generator continuous fuel autonomy of 96 h.
PWR-UTIL-U7X：In the Production environment, Valley Regional Gymnasium demonstrates active backup generator readiness, alongside on-site fuel capacity delivering a backup generator continuous fuel autonomy of 48 h.

information_points.title: Potable water storage（WATER）
information_points.content:
PWR-WATER-5IK：For Bayside Civic Pavilion, dedicated emergency reserve tanks hold a reserve potable water volume of 24,000 L of treated water.
PWR-WATER-Y2D：For Highland Sports Arena, the municipal water authority audit verifies a reserve potable water volume of 12,000 L maintained in dedicated secure storage tanks.
PWR-WATER-Z0V：For Valley Regional Gymnasium, the reserve potable water volume in secure shelter storage tanks is 18,000 L according to the municipal water authority audit.
